reason: Coolzy sells one core product line, the Coolzy-Pro and Coolzy-Go personal air conditioners for bed and tent cooling. On coolzy.com/us on 2026-11-17 both were sold out: the Coolzy-Pro listed at $389 (regular $449) with no add-to-cart button, and the Coolzy-Go page returned 404. The shop page says stock will return in 'late 2026 or early 2027'. A sold-out product can't win a segment for a shopper today, and the evidence doesn't show it winning on the main pain point (real cooling): 74% of 617 Trustpilot reviews are 1-star, and Trustpilot has suspended the rating for a guideline breach. No honest page exists. The store does ship to the US and has two in-stock accessories, so they are recorded here.

ac-accessory: Bed tents, exhaust hoses and add-ons for portable and personal air conditioners.

products.name: Coolzy Igloo Bed Tent for Coolzy Personal Air Conditioners (double to king beds)
specs: 2 adults, or 1 adult and 2 kids (maker's estimate)
Coolzy, Coolzy-Pro, Coolzy-Go (air conditioner sold separately)
products.warranty: Coolzy's US terms give 2 years from purchase on defects, valid in the USA only. The terms don't say whether accessories are covered. The owner pays freight to return a unit for warranty service.
products.returns: No change-of-mind returns (Coolzy US terms, section 4.1). Cancelling before dispatch costs a $15 admin fee. Refunds on warranty claims are partial and set case by case.
products.summary: A bed tent that fits over a double to king bed and holds the cold air from a Coolzy personal air conditioner around the sleepers instead of the whole room. It doesn't cool anything by itself.
products.fit: For people who already own a Coolzy-Pro or Coolzy-Go and want the bed space to cool faster than the open room allows.
caveats: On 2026-11-17 the Coolzy-Pro and Coolzy-Go were both sold out on Coolzy's US store, with restock expected in late 2026 or early 2027. Without one of them, the tent is just a bed tent.
Coolzy doesn't accept change-of-mind returns, so make sure the tent fits your bed before you order.

Coolzy ships to the mainland US only, and not to Washington State, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico. Accessories normally cost $20 to ship unless a free-shipping offer is running. The site banner showed free mainland shipping on 2026-11-17.
The product page says the 'Focus Enhancer' is not included.

Trustpilot showed 617 coolzy.com reviews on 2026-11-17, 74% of them 1-star, with the score suspended for a guideline breach. Most complaints say the air conditioner cools weakly. Coolzy replies that some buyers bought from look-alike sites.

specs: Hot-air exhaust hose to a window
On a flexible pipe, can be aimed in any direction
Small bedrooms, camper vans and caravans
products.warranty: Coolzy's US terms give 2 years from purchase on defects, valid in the USA only. The terms don't say whether accessories are covered.
products.returns: No change-of-mind returns (Coolzy US terms, section 4.1). Cancelling before dispatch costs a $15 admin fee.
products.summary: An add-on hose that carries the Coolzy's warm exhaust out through a window, so the heat doesn't build up in a small bedroom or van.
products.fit: For Coolzy owners using the unit in a small closed room or vehicle, where the warm exhaust otherwise undoes the cooling.
caveats: Fits Coolzy units only. On 2026-11-17 the Coolzy-Pro and Coolzy-Go were sold out on the US store, with restock expected in late 2026 or early 2027.
A Trustpilot reviewer said gaps in the Long Tail attachment let hot air back into the tent. Seal the joints.
The Long Tail may ship separately from the air conditioner, with its own tracking number.
Coolzy doesn't accept change-of-mind returns. It ships to the mainland US only, excluding Washington State, Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico.

notes: Store check 2026-11-17 (WebFetch; coolzy.com/us is WordPress/WooCommerce, not Shopify, so storecheck.py failed). (1) Coolzy-Pro: regular $449, sale $389, out of stock, no add-to-cart button. Specs: 1,100 W cooling, 340 W draw, 120 V NEMA 5-15P, R134a, 37 lb. The text gives no BTU or noise figure. The page contradicts itself on whether the Focus Enhancer is included. Shop page: 'Due to extraordinary demand, we have sold out of stock for this season... back with more stock in late 2026 or early 2027.' (2) Coolzy-Go: listed as 'Sold Out due to early demand', and its product URL returns 404. (3) Igloo Tent: $99, 'In stock', add-to-cart button present. (4) Long Tail: $75, 'In stock', add-to-cart button present. Add a Coolzy-Pro record when it is back in stock. CODES: Awin listed none. The brand site shows no code, only a 'Limited Time Offer | Free Shipping USA MAINLAND' banner. PAIN POINTS: from 18 low-star reviews on one Trustpilot page: doesn't cool or underperforms 15, returns and refunds 11, customer service 7, overpriced compared with a fan 6, suspected scam or look-alike site 5, misleading claims 4, shipping delays 4, accessories didn't help 2, arrived dead 2, noise 1, power use 1. On ProductReview.com.au the Coolzy-Pro scores 3.5 from 56 reviews, about 70% positive. Owners there say it is a one-person spot cooler, about as loud as a pedestal fan on medium, and one measured a 360 W draw. Trustpilot overall: 617 reviews, 74% 1-star, rating suspended. SEGMENTS CONSIDERED: bed and sleep cooling (BedJet or Chilisleep-type products would lead, and Coolzy is sold out), tent and camping AC (Zero Breeze Mark 3 is already on the site), and small-room AC. Coolzy honestly wins none of them today. UNVERIFIED, kept off the records: the tent's dimensions (shown only in an image on the US page; an AU retailer lists 210 x 201 cm), tent weight and materials, whether the warranty covers accessories, whether the tent works with other brands' air conditioners.
